description_en: Purchases a pay-as-you-go Data Management (DMS) resource
description_zh: 调用BuyPayAsYouGoOrder接口，购买DMS按量付费的商品
name: BuyPayAsYouGoOrder

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。

取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en:
The type of the resource that you want to purchase.

VersionType: DMS that supports control modes
SensitiveDataProtection: DMS that supports sensitive data protection
parameters.help_zh:
商品类型。
versionType：管控模式
SensitiveDataProtection：敏感数据保护
parameters.name: commodity_type

parameters.help_en:
The number of database instances that you want to use DMS to manage.

A quota can be used for only one database instance
parameters.help_zh:
购买管控模式或敏感数据的使用额度。

一个额度仅可用于一个数据库实例
parameters.name: ins_num

parameters.help_en:
The control mode of DMS. Valid values:

stand: Stable Change
safety: Security Collaboration
parameters.help_zh:
购买商品类型为管控模式时，有以下类型可选择：
stand：稳定变更
safety：安全协同
parameters.name: version_type

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed

InstanceId.description_en: If the purchase is successful, the ID of the purchased instance is returned
InstanceId.description_zh: 购买成功后，返回购买的订单实例ID
InstanceId.title_en: 购买成功后，返回购买的订单实例ID
InstanceId.title_zh: 购买成功后，返回购买的订单实例ID

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败
